title: Grateful Dead Live at Shrine Auditorium on 1967-11-11
lineage: SBD Reel from WB Vault to reel @ 7.5 IPS to reel@ 7.5 IPS to digital domain. Korg MR 1000 at 1 bit 5.6 mhz to 24-96 via Korg software. Taped by: Dan Healy; Transfer By: Matt Smith & Bob Menke; Mastering By: Derek McCabe

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard capture of a raw, psychedelic 1968‑era show highlighted by New Potato Caboose, Caution and soaring Lovelight solos.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its surprising clarity given the era’s equipment, with listeners noting a clean remaster that lets every instrument shine. Musically the performance is described as an improvisational fireworks display – “raw” energy, standout versions of New Potato Caboose, Cryptical Reprise, Alligator → Caution and two epic Lovelight solos make this a fan‑favorite snapshot of the band’s pre‑‘68 surge.

ai_rating.rationale: All eight reviews are strongly positive (4–5 stars), emphasizing both excellent musical moments and a clear, well‑remastered soundboard source.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, dynamic and surprisingly pristine for a 1960s tape; remaster praised, no dropout or major flaws mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A raw, improvisational set that builds psychedelic intensity; the band rides a high‑energy groove from early jams into soaring solos, delivering a cohesive, mind‑blowing experience.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Multiple reviewers spotlight his two Lovelight solos – one with distorted hammer‑on phrases and another with machine‑gun riffing – and marvel at how he balances fierce guitar work with vocals on Death Don't Have No Mercy.
